label: main season
summary: Recommend clearance for sign-off. The survey team's recorded observation of an object that looked like EO (E3) is direct evidence and a target. National criteria provide no technical survey, so clearance is the prescribed next outcome. E1's report of 17 years of safe use does not negate direct evidence.
flags: E3 is an observed apparent EO item documented and reported by the survey team; its identity is not independently established in the dossier.

checks.detail: Every item of the evidence log is in the register.
The national criteria provide no technical survey, so clearance takes its place; evidence to target: E3.

E1.quote: he has cut firewood and timber in the area every year for the past 17 years, and has never found anything or heard of an accident there.
E1.note: First-hand land user reports repeated safe use over many years; it may account for the weaker, unidentified rumour, but cannot negate the team's direct observation.

E2.quote: people should keep away from the area because of mines, but could not say who had seen anything, or where.
E2.note: An unverified second-hand warning is weak indirect evidence from a source unable to identify any first-hand witness.

E3.quote: The survey team saw an object that looked like explosive ordnance on the ground beside the stream.
E3.note: The team's own recorded observation of an apparent EO object is direct evidence and a target; safe-distance documentation does not determine its identity.
